summary: Hardening review passed for the exact v0.3.19 distribution candidate. Guided onboarding remains the first explicit project-configuration step; the new questionnaire and documentation then bind a versioned serial campaign to actual goal, model, cumulative budget, release/deployment authority, outcomes, vision/principles and accepted decisions. The committed fresh-clone fixture proves unanswered onboarding is read-only, rejects missing release authority before worker launch, and then drives two dependent local releases plus an achieved goal audit through one controller; deterministic workers make no model or hosted calls. Existing guided first-release coverage passes, ordinary and linked A/B/C campaigns pass with 18 recovery regressions, and the historical live hash check now fetches only immutable v0.3.26 into a disposable repository when a ref-specific cache lacks that tag. Source maintenance task/plan records are archived under non-executable evidence, while published runnable state contains only task-schema-smoke. Claims are explicitly limited to synthetic local Git and the separate 437.987-second native-Codex proof; no overnight, broad-model, hosted-effect or production guarantee is made. Declared exact-candidate verification passes and no blocking finding remains.
